about_short_description.short_description: Echoes HQ measure and communicate engineering activity.

product.name: Echoes Engineering Insights Platform
product.description: A platform that consolidates data from various development tools to provide engineering leaders with insights into team activity, project delivery, and organizational health.

product.name: DORA Metrics Monitoring
product.description: A service that tracks key DevOps performance indicators like lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to recover to help identify engineering bottlenecks and risks.

product.name: Project Tracking and Forecasting
product.description: A tool that tracks engineering initiatives and projects, providing real-time status updates and forecasting estimated completion dates based on current progress and scope.

product.name: Automated Anomaly Detection
product.description: A feature that automatically identifies blockers, bottlenecks, and anomalies in engineering workflows to highlight risks and improvement opportunities.

product.name: Teams Allocation and Insights
product.description: A service that visualizes how engineering teams allocate their efforts across projects and business priorities to assess focus and alignment.

product.name: Slack & Microsoft Teams Reporting
product.description: Integration features that deliver engineering activity reports and alerts directly to Slack and Microsoft Teams channels for real-time communication.
